title: Comments
description: Approve, answer and clear out what readers write.

row.address: Address {{hash}}: a keyed hash of the commenter's IP address (the same address gives the same hash)

report.title_one: {{count}} of {{total}} comments could not be changed
report.title_other: {{count}} of {{total}} comments could not be changed

delete.body_one: The comment by {{name}} and every reply to it are removed for good. This cannot be undone.
delete.body_other: These {{count}} comments and every reply to them are removed for good. This cannot be undone.

reply.label: Reply to {{name}}
reply.hint: Posted under your name and shown at once.
reply.hintApprove: Approves the comment first, then posts your reply under your name.
reply.closed: This post does not take comments now (it is not public, or comments are off).
reply.approvedOnly: The comment is approved, but the reply was not posted: {{detail}}

pending.title: Nothing waits for moderation
pending.body: New comments that need a look land here.

approved.title: No approved comments
approved.body: Approved comments show on the site, and here.

spam.title: No spam
spam.body: Comments marked as spam stay here until you delete them.

trash.title: Trash is empty
trash.body: Trashed comments stay here until you delete them.

filtered.body: Nothing with this status on this item.

shortcuts.approve: Approve the selection or the focused comment
shortcuts.unapprove: Unapprove the selection or the focused comment
shortcuts.spam: Mark the selection or the focused comment as spam
shortcuts.trash: Trash the selection or the focused comment
